info.description: REST APIs for managing CloudContactAI Webhooks. Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications when specific events occur (e.g., message sent, message received, contact unsubscribed).
info.title: CloudContactAI Webhooks API Documentation

get.description: This endpoint allows you to list all registered webhooks for your account. Your identity is inferred from the API key.

200.description: Successful request, returns a list of all registered webhooks

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

post.description: This endpoint allows you to register a new webhook endpoint for your account.

200.description: Successful request, creates a webhook and returns the registered details.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

get.description: This endpoint allows you to get a webhook by its ID.

200.description: Successful request, returns the webhook details.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update a webhook by its ID.

200.description: Successful request, updates the webhook and returns the updated details.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a webhook by its ID.

401.description: Unauthorized, you didn't provide a valid access token

403.description: Forbidden resource, you don't have access to this resource

404.description: The requested resource has not been found.

BearerAuth.description: API Key passed as a Bearer token. Example: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

url.description: The URL that will receive webhook notifications

events.description: List of event types this webhook is subscribed to

url.description: The URL that will receive webhook notifications

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to

secret.description: A secret used to sign webhook payloads for verification via the X-CCAI-Signature header
